topic: creating an approval log for AI-assisted work

sources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources.supports: Voluntary framework organized around Govern, Map, Measure and Manage; does not mandate a universal approval-log template.

sources.title: NIST AI RMF Core
sources.supports: Framework outcomes and activities are tailored to context rather than one universal ordered checklist.

sources.title: NIST Generative AI Profile
sources.supports: Generative AI risk practices can include additional human review, tracking, documentation and management oversight; the profile does not prescribe this schema.

sources.title: NIST AI RMF Playbook
sources.supports: Voluntary suggested actions and documentation practices accompanying the framework.

limitations: The template is an editorial example, not a NIST requirement or a compliance guarantee.
Review depth depends on impact, context and the authority of the reviewer.
Content approval does not itself authorize sending, changing records or making commitments.
